decisions.executionNote: Begin symmetric elbow-up approach; tilt open grippers toward tabletop while staying high. Object heights and tool offset need visual refinement.
Complete downward orientation above the front chocolate bar and right wooden toy; keep grippers open for alignment.
Lower gradually and align left jaws across the diagonal chocolate bar; right jaws approach the toy. Check visual tool-to-object offset before closing.
Close at current contact-limited height and lift vertically to test retention of front bar and right toy from RGB.
Left bar visibly retained: carry toward middle basket. Right toy stayed on table and shifted rearward; reopen and approach its updated location.
Replan the interrupted carry with smaller increments and slightly lower height to preserve elbow-up continuity; right aligns slowly over shifted toy.
Lower the retained bar to regain reach margin before entering blue basket; descend and close right gripper around visually centered toy.
Seat the retained chocolate over the blue basket and release; lift right toy vertically to verify retention before transport.
Bar appears within blue basket footprint; release without pushing farther into reach limit, then retract. Continue vertical toy retention test.
Blue bar is released. Move left toward remaining chocolate while right carries visibly retained toy toward red basket at reduced height for reach margin.
Align left over second bar using table projection and correct accumulated tilt; advance retained toy over red basket slowly.
Right toy appears blocked by basket front wall; lift and modestly tilt forward rather than push. Left closes on centered second bar and begins lift test.
Bridge the right tracking residual with a small intermediate target, then lift toy clear of the red rim. Left closes on second chocolate.
Left transports visibly retained second bar. Right backs off the rim while lifting, with an intermediate target bridging tracking error; maintain closed grips.
Carry second bar toward blue. With toy now clear of front wall, advance right slowly and tilt to reach inside red without stretching the elbow.
Release toy inside red. Second chocolate slipped at basket rim; reopen left and retreat above its new tabletop position. Right withdraws toward nearer watch.
Descend open left gripper onto fallen second bar. Right aligns downward over near watch for a centerline transfer, keeping arms separated.
Fine-align chocolate and descend to watch band height, close both, then lift vertically to check retention before carrying.
Lift and tilt retained chocolate above rim before placing. Carry watch toward a clear front-center staging point for a sequential left-arm transfer.
Watch moves to front-center staging and is released. Left chocolate appears to have slipped again at rim; reopen and lower over its updated tabletop location.
Back left away from basket interference and rotate to match the fallen bar's new angle. Right leaves staged watch and moves clear toward remaining watch.
Approach the reoriented chocolate from clear tabletop space and align right over the second watch. Descend open for visual alignment.
Close both aligned grasps and lift straight up, avoiding sideways contact with basket rims until objects are visibly clear.
Raise and lean retained bar forward over blue rim with small increments. Move second watch rearward toward a separate center staging location, away from left arm.
Bar did not retain during tilt; realign jaws with its now fore-aft axis and approach the center. Bring held second watch to a separate front-center staging spot.
Lower straight onto centered bar and close at table grasp height. Release second watch at staging point and withdraw right, leaving center accessible.
Allow centered chocolate grasp to settle, then lift vertically without rotating. Keep right open and parked clear of center transfers.
Chocolate is visibly retained after vertical lift. Raise further first, then lean and advance over blue basket while keeping right parked.
Move retained bar fully inside the blue footprint, release, and retreat gently. Right remains clear while basket placement settles.
Withdraw left toward remaining toy with downward open grasp. Let released bars settle; one may have shifted near the left basket and needs rechecking.
Grasp the remaining wooden toy with left arm and lift to verify. Keep right clear for a sequential centerline handoff.
Toy stayed low rather than lifting; reopen and grasp lower around its body with a small rearward correction. Right remains safely parked.
Lift toy and bring it to clear center staging above the watches. Right stays separated. A chocolate is now visibly in white and will need correction.
Set toy down at center, open and withdraw left before right approaches. Preserve lateral arm separation for sequential transfer.
Left moves rearward to the farther staged watch while right approaches center-staged toy. Separate their approach corridors longitudinally; no arm crossing.
Fine-align left on rear staged watch and right on shifted toy, descend and close. Keep the near staged watch clear of right jaws.
Lift left watch and move it into left workspace. Right toy was nudged rather than retained; reopen and recenter rearward over its body before closing again.
Separate the arms before further center work. Left watch was not retained; reopen and back away. Lift the right toy and carry it into right workspace for retention check.
Transport retained toy high toward red, avoiding rim. Retry rear watch with left approach shifted rearward based on wrist view; keep center corridors separated.
Close on rear watch with corrected wrist alignment and test lift. Advance retained wooden toy over red rim while leaning forward for reach margin.
Carry visibly retained watch toward white. Toy slipped before entering red; reopen and retreat to regrasp it on tabletop without pressing the rim.
Bring retained watch above left basket with rim clearance. Recenter right on fallen toy's torso and close without transporting until retention is checked.
Release watch to the left of misplaced chocolate in white, then withdraw. Lift right toy straight above rim height before any forward lean.
Right carries securely lifted toy inside red at high clearance. Left approaches misplaced chocolate inside white, orienting across its width without disturbing deposited watch.
Release second toy inside red and retract right. Left aligns on upper portion of misplaced chocolate, away from watch, then closes inside white.
Both toys appear in red. Begin resetting right. Left reopens and lowers to secure thin chocolate below the prior high pinch, keeping clear of watch.
Lift chocolate clear of white basket before lateral transfer. Complete right-arm return toward recorded origin with open gripper and continuous elbow-up motion.
Carry visibly retained chocolate sideways above the basket rims from white to blue, preserving grasp orientation. Fine-correct right to its recorded origin.
Release retained bar within blue without extending farther. Retract and reorient left toward final center-staged watch; right remains reset and open.
Replan interrupted retreat using smaller increments near the reach boundary. Chocolate released into blue; withdraw open toward final watch while maintaining elbow-up continuity.
Approach final staged watch with left gripper, restoring downward orientation and using the rearward alignment that retained the previous watch. Right stays at origin.
Descend on the visually centered final watch, close, and lift vertically to confirm retention. Both chocolate bars and toys appear in their assigned baskets.
Final watch remained on table and shifted slightly forward. Reopen, recenter on the updated ring, and approach lower before retrying the grasp.
Close at the contact-limited height with watch now centered between jaws, settle the grasp, and lift vertically for visual retention check.
Final watch is visibly retained. Carry it into left workspace above the tabletop before approaching the white basket; right remains reset.
Lift and lean the retained final watch over the white basket with clearance from its front wall, keeping the already reset right arm still.
Release final watch over white and withdraw with open gripper, beginning left-arm reset. Correct the small right-origin drift while preserving both configurations.
Both watches, both bars, and both toys are visibly in the assigned baskets. Return left to recorded origin with open gripper and smooth configuration continuity; right stays reset.
